name: Interior Cluster Sweden
description: A furniture and interior design cluster of companies - furniture manufacturers, designers, subcontractors and municipalities that support the local business community. A national member organization connecting local and regional stakeholders in the industry.

name: Föreningen Skråhantverkarna
description: A Swedish association of traditional craftspeople, formed in 1983 to preserve trades and skills that might otherwise disappear - bookbinders, gilders, violin-makers, silversmiths and other heritage crafts, alongside several trades that overlap furniture and interior work.
note: Showing only members whose craft relates to furniture, interior, or building work (22 of the association's full 45-member roster) - not every trade this association represents.
